descriptions: {LOCATION}. The {ANTAGONIST} is using the {MACGUFFIN} against you — you can feel it.
A {CHARACTER} blocks your path. 'You should have taken it,' they say. 'Now we improvise.'

commands.look: The {CHARACTER} looks grim. The {ANTAGONIST} is closing in. North is the only option.
commands.talk to {CHARACTER}: 'I know another way. But it will cost us. Go north — now.'

latents.fact: a {ADJ} token — the kind used for passage or barter — has been slid under the door from outside
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} token, edge-worn. Someone pushed it under the door but didn't knock.

latents.fact: the {ANTAGONIST} left something behind when they passed through — a mark on the doorframe that glows faintly
there is a second set of footprints in the dust that do not belong to anyone currently in the room
